title: The Mirror
summary: Songbird asks V to go into a shielded container in the Longshore Stacks for a young netrunner held there.
description: A young netrunner is held in the Longshore Stacks by a crew that sells runners to whoever pays. Songbird can still hear his channels but cannot reach him, so she asks V to go in.

start.bringUp: Songbird calls in a controlled voice. A young netrunner is being held in the Longshore Stacks by a crew that sells runners to whoever pays, and she can still hear the channels. She cannot reach him. You can. She is not asking a favour, and for once it is not about herself.

stacks.name: the Longshore Stacks container maze in Dogtown

last-container.name: the last container, the one with no light

contact.name: a contact in Dogtown, a nameless woman

S5.open.01.text: V. I need to tell you something. Please don't say anything for ten seconds.

S5.open.02.text: There's a runner in the Longshore Stacks. Nineteen. Held by a crew that sells runners.

S5.open.03.text: I can listen. I can't reach him. You can.

S5.open.04.text: It isn't a favour. It's the first thing I've asked that isn't about me.

S5.open.05.text: Will you go? I'm asking, not telling. I've done enough telling.

S5.open.06.text: Stay on the line. I'll be your eyes as far as I can.

S5.s2.01.text: Crane lookout, east. Don't go under it.

S5.s2.02.text: Two in the lane. Count to twenty. Now.

S5.s2.03.text: That container. The last one. The one with no light.

S5.s3.02.text: I know. I know. Tell me he's alive.

S5.s3.06.text: I used to be in a chair like that. Not that chair. Not that room.

S5.s3.07.text: What would you have wanted someone to say to you?

S5.s4.01.text: Car's behind the crane. Left. Left. Go.

S5.s4.02.text: Two behind you. Keep going. I'll hold the road.

S5.s4.03.text: Drop him at the address. She doesn't ask questions. That's her gift.

S5.s5.01.text: You went where I couldn't. That's the whole job.

S5.s5.02.text: Do you think he'll be all right? Be honest.

S5.bark.down.a.text: That's the noise gone. Check your back.

S5.close.01.text: Thank you. I'll say it plainly. Thank you.

S5.close.02.text: Are you hurt? Answer first, then speak.

g1.know: You know the Stacks, the squad, the boy and the dead zone.
g1.wants: A yes that costs V something and does not feel like an order.

g2.asks: What would you have wanted someone to say to you?
g2.know: You know the boy's state and what you said to him.
g2.secret: Nobody said anything to you, and you remember that.
g2.wants: An answer to give the boy.

g3.asks: Do you think he'll be all right?
g3.know: You know how the rescue ended.
g3.secret: You fear you will be on the other end of the next call.

stages.label: Songbird asks V to go into the Stacks
stages.objective: Answer Songbird's call about the netrunner in the Stacks
stages.know: You are calling V about a young netrunner held in the Longshore Stacks. You cannot promise anything, and you want V to say yes freely.
stages.wants: V to say yes to going into the Stacks.

stages.label: Songbird counts the lane guards for V
stages.objective: Work toward the last container in the Stacks with Songbird
stages.know: V is in the Stacks, working toward the last container. You count the lane guards through V's ear, and you stay calm while the count holds.
stages.wants: V to reach the last container without being seen.

stages.label: Songbird goes silent at the last container
stages.objective: Go into the shielded container where Songbird's voice cuts out
stages.know: V is at the shielded container. Your voice cuts out at its door, and you can only wait for V to come back out.
stages.wants: V to get inside, get the boy out and come back to the signal.

stages.label: Songbird asks whether the boy is out
stages.objective: Check with Songbird whether the boy is out
stages.know: V has been inside the container and back. You want to know whether he is out, alive and breathing, and what you would have wanted someone to say to you.
stages.wants: V to say whether the boy is out and alive.

choices.means: V says the boy is out of the chair and alive
V says the boy did not make it out

stages.label: V drives the boy to a contact in Dogtown
stages.objective: Drive the boy to the Dogtown contact, with Songbird on the radio
stages.know: V has the boy and is driving him out. Some of the squad is behind V. You will hold the road, and you will tell V where to go.
stages.wants: V to get the boy to the contact and not to be caught.

stages.label: Songbird talks about the rescue
stages.objective: Talk with Songbird about the rescue
stages.know: The boy is with the contact. You say the thing you have not said before: what it is to be on the other end of a rescue.
stages.wants: V to hear what you did not get, and to be honest about the boy.

saved.memory: You went into a shielded container in the Longshore Stacks and got a young netrunner out while Songbird waited outside the silence.

saved-loud.memory: You got a young netrunner out of the Longshore Stacks with the squad on your back, and Songbird asked whether you were hurt.

too-late.memory: The boy in the Longshore Stacks did not make it out, and Songbird went quiet.

abandoned.memory: You did not go into the Longshore Stacks, and Songbird texted that she understood.
